title: Group-isomorphic compatible charts for every saturated log blowup representative
statement: For every saturated log blowup $b:X'\to X$ along a nonempty coherent log ideal $I$ [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], each point $x\in X'$ belongs to a compatible fs chart [def-per-fs-log-smooth-etale] for which the induced homomorphism on group completions is bijective and the canonical scheme comparison with the chart fibre product is an isomorphism. The assertion concerns every representative of the fs universal property.

source.place: VIII 3.3.5--3.3.11, pp.107--108, especially 3.3.11; parent proof step 6.

proof.text: Choose an etale affine chart P for the ideal and its nonempty finite generator set E. The coherent log ideal construction supplies a canonical saturated blowup with the tensor chart cover A tensor over Z[P] with Z[Qe saturated], together with normalized group-completion equivalences for every Qe saturated.

Both the inclusion of P in Qe saturated and the group-completion equivalence are fixed on original elements of P. Thus the induced group homomorphism is inverse to the normalized equivalence and is bijective. Compatibility with the actual chart monomials identifies the comparison with the tensor-spectrum pullback isomorphism. The tensor charts cover every point above the base chart.

The fs universal properties of the canonical blowup and the given representative supply mutually inverse log maps: each composite is the unique factorization of the same structure map, hence the identity. Transport the chart cover across this isomorphism. The full section-map equations preserve chart compatibility and the canonical comparison. Choosing a chart through a point gives the assertion.

theorem saturatedLogBlowup_chartCover {X X' : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}}
    (b : EtaleLogHom X' X) (I : X.logStructure.IdealFamily)
    (hb : IsSaturatedLogBlowup b I) (x : X'.scheme) :
    ∃ c : FSLogChart b, x ∈ Set.range c.V.hom ∧
      Function.Bijective c.groupMap ∧ IsIso c.comparison
